content.title: PG&E unveils $73 billion spending plan to meet surging data-center energy demand
content.summary: The company had said in July it was working to serve 10 gigawatts (GW) of new electricity demand from data center projects over the next ten years.  Power consumption is expected to hit record highs in 2025 and 2026, driven by a surge in demand from data centers due to increased adoption of artificial intelligence, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA).  PG&E Corp has also been blamed for sparking numerous wildfires, including some of California's most deadly, and has been making investments to improve the reliability of its power grid.
